html:
Here’s the audiogram of a friend of mine who plays rock music.

The horizontal axis is frequency; the vertical axis is the lowest sound pressure level at which each frequency can be heard; the dashed red line is the threshold of normal hearing. As you can see, at 2–3 kHz my friend’s hearing is pretty much... like this:

So:

Headphones come in a thousand kinds, but safety is rule number one. Blast the volume year after year, and your family’s tears will run. (A riff on the road-safety slogan from the Chinese sci-fi film The Wandering Earth.)
